summary: Stopping cleanly: update.json is unchanged and retained, the controller reports no_change with no execution requested, and there is no open gap or pending consequence left to investigate — the allocation expires in under two minutes, so the honest move is to yield rather than re-issue the same submission or invent marginal edits. Everything the investigation set out to establish is in the stored record with receipts, controls and repeats: a node restarted with RestoreCommittedLogs whose newest configuration entry sits at or below the persisted commit index comes back without that configuration (430d7ba602ed4666bdfe63a96c71e2fc and e0ef28c2bc89481aa6b3af478422de7c), with the trigger pinned to the persisted commit index by 656e33fb90f24c58a94928eeeeb938aa and 202311f4911e4af5828d49134f37811c; the consequences are empty-configuration loss of electability cluster-wide and among a live quorum (4f4a771f03b649c2a5703b0ff279ff3a, 7afe8c0403874dbeb0a917a3ee9ed837 and repeats), silent membership change producing concurrent leaders, truncation of a committed client write and FSM divergence (6f9feceeefb245c288a7fd1f4497b83c, 1f95cb0a02bc4577a5a9f1ab627fe903, 108a83830e904d90a9236738033c2c74, e5ad9e5149fa4255b61e7826bf6b8064), premature commit under a resurrected removed voter and under a forgotten added voter (226f9762f0b444f69c154b35fe0788f3, b1daa1f4c9444b8d857bc7e0ab761691 with their repeats and boundary), and VerifyLeader confirming a stale leader; the repairs are bounded to a later configuration entry (6d6abaf163524e64878c6c9810de2461), a flag-disabled restart (81163da076c64417bd48e0f79260d73d) or RecoverCluster on a stopped node (0440f054115e44f4a0234c7a4ef67150), with live bootstrap and an incoming snapshot to a complete-log node ruled out. The only loose thread is bookkeeping, and it is recorded for whoever reads the run next: question nodes 9c549c026d7341f2b1e328826eac6dc3-question-0 and 4099b8f3cc5c45d2b3c3049ce5a5c0de-question-0 carry the same restart text, and the interpretation 4099b8f3cc5c45d2b3c3049ce5a5c0de-interpretation-0 remains attached to the older node while the controller's references point @restart_config at the newer one; I left both untouched because repointing the interpretation would detach it from the history and prior interpretations stored under the older id, and that edit is not worth risking in the closing seconds.
